gloss: before the spirit of the deceased; condolence offering

definitions.gloss: before the spirit of the deceased; condolence offering
definitions.explanation: A term written on condolence money envelopes at Japanese funerals, meaning the offering is presented before the spirit of the deceased. Used at Buddhist funerals during the mourning period before the 49th day.

examples.japanese: {御霊前|ごれいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared an envelope inscribed with 'goreizen.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{通夜|つや}→通夜：16026_tsuya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{御霊前|ごれいぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I brought a condolence offering to the wake.

examples.japanese: {仏式|ぶっしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{御霊前|ごれいぜん}、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: At Buddhist funerals, 'goreizen' is used until the 49th day, and 'gobutsuzen' is used after that.

notes:
Literally "before the honorable spirit." This is the most common inscription written on the {不祝儀袋|ぶしゅうぎぶくろ} (condolence envelope) at Japanese funerals. It is used when the deceased's spirit has not yet become a Buddha, which in Buddhist belief occurs on the 49th day after death.

After the 49th day memorial (⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧), the appropriate inscription changes to ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧ (before the Buddha), as the spirit is believed to have attained Buddhahood. When unsure of the denomination, {御霊前|ごれいぜん} is generally the safest choice, as it is accepted by most Buddhist sects (except {浄土真宗|じょうどしんしゅう}, which uses ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧ from the start).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {御霊前|ごれいぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to present a condolence offering
- {御霊前|ごれいぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧: condolence envelope
- {御霊前|ごれいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}ける: to offer flowers before the spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧: before the Buddha (used after the 49th day)
- ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧: condolence money
- {御香典|ごこうでん}: condolence money (honorific form)
